verdict.rationale: Modal documents its own way to serve applications publicly: functions can become HTTPS endpoints that scale with traffic. That partly covers the 'serve applications' half of the story, but there is no evidence of exposing arbitrary ports from a container or sandbox, and nothing on private networking between instances. Missing for 10: arbitrary port exposure/tunneling from instances, private networking between instances, in-depth docs and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose ports to serve applications from my instance and connect instances over private networking

citations.quote: Turn any function into an HTTPS endpoint that scales with traffic and idles at zero.
